messages:
jiwoo kim: Heads up — noticed a detokenization regression on vertical Japanese / zhuyin rendering after the int4 quant bringup on staging. BLEU down ~6.2 vs q8 baseline on the vertical-text testset. Repro steps and example below.

jiwoo kim: Repro (staging):
```
# eval command
python eval.py --model redwood-xyz-1-int4 --testset data/vertical_jp_zhuyin.json --detok vertical --batch 64
```

jiwoo kim: Sample mismatch: 
```
input: 縦書きテスト
gold: 縦書きテスト
model: 縦 書 き テ ス ト
```

sam roberts: :eyes: that spacing is classic token-splitting between han/kanji/hiragana boundaries. Did the tokenizer merge table change?

anya petrov: Any config diffs between the q8 and int4 artifacts? normalizer/Unicode NFKC flags maybe. I remember a recent PR that touched tokenizer normalizer for zhuyin.

jiwoo kim: I diffed the artifacts quickly: int4 build used tokenizers v0.13.0 while q8 used 0.12.7 (packaging mismatch). Also the detokenizer mode `vertical` falls back to char-join when unknown. Could be a fallback trigger.

marcus li: If the tokenizer version changed, merge rules may differ. But odd that orientation (vertical) would change token boundaries unless detok logic is sensitive. Can you paste the edge-case tokenization?

jiwoo kim: Tokenized output (int4): `['縦', '書', 'き', 'テ', 'ス', 'ト']`  q8 baseline: `['縦書き', 'テスト']`

sam roberts: OK that's a merge-table/regression. Two immediate checks: 1) run the same tokenizer binary (v0.12.7) on the int4 model weights to see if tokenization is model-attributed or tokenizer-attributed; 2) run the int4 tokenizer on a few non-vertical samples to confirm it's not detok-only.

jiwoo kim: Did quick 1): running v0.12.7 tokenizer with the int4 model tokens reproduces q8-like merges. So tokenizer packaging is the culprit. The int4 release pipeline pulled a newer tokenizers wheel.

anya petrov: Great catch. We should: a) pin tokenizer wheel for the int4 release, b) add a regression unit test for vertical-layout CJK combos (zhuyin/hangul + kanji), and c) add a preflight that validates tokenization parity vs baseline for locale-specific sets.

token-bot: ALERT: regression-suite/vertical-text-eval failed on staging for redwood-xyz-1-int4 (BLEU delta -6.2). See: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/vertical-text-eval/1968034567

marcus li: I'll open the pin PR for packaging (small change), and add a test in evals/regressions/vertical_cjk.json with the sample set jiwoo used. Sam can bisect the tokenizer wheel change range if we want to find the offending commit.

sam roberts: I'll bisect tomorrow AM and coordinate with tokenizers upstream. For now, can we revert the int4 rollout to use q8's tokenizer wheel so customers on dedicated/private don't see the regression?

jiwoo kim: Revert approved by eng-ml lead. I'll file the rollback ticket and attach the failing examples + perf numbers. Also adding the vertical test to our nightly regression suite.

anya petrov: Note for docs/console: call out that some locale-sensitive detokenization can be sensitive to tokenizer packaging. Add a short blurb in the model bring-up checklist.

sam roberts: Plan: (1) pin wheel + revert on int4 rollout (hotfix), (2) add unit/regression tests (PR Marcus), (3) bisect tokenizer changes upstream (Sam), (4) add preflight check to bringup scripts (Anya). Assigning owners in GH after this thread.

jiwoo kim: Thanks all — I'll add the failing samples and a tiny harness to reproduce in the issue now. :thumbsup:
